verdict.rationale: Wise documents sending payments globally in 40+ currencies, including business payments via API from a Wise account, with most transfers arriving in under 20 seconds. Fee transparency is supported by the "no hidden fees or markups" claim, rate locks of up to 24 hours, and a comparison API for price information. missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of the fee breakdown shown before sending, independent or hands-on corroboration of fee transparency on business transfers.
